original.target_description: Problem 9: perceived progress (question 2) and end commitment (question 3), following an initial-commitment question. Both outcomes are named by the neutral description, which does not select a single test.

notes: Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no extraction attempted for them. Primary source identity verified. The printed common participant count is 64 for all three questions, with no stated exclusions; retained only as a candidate because outcome correspondence is unresolved. Progress responses: Jim 83%, Equal 11%, Kyle 6%. End commitment: Jim 72%, Equal 12%, Kyle 16%. The source states p < .01 by chi-square for the last two questions versus 50%; it prints no numeric chi-square statistic for either. No N derived from df, and no chi-square recomputed from percentages.
